text: And for the early birds: the DOORBUSTER. Clears a path to the deals. And through the people standing near the deals.
Nobody ever does. That's the beauty of it.
Ten seconds! Which is longer than most corporate mergers, and FAR more honest.
Then they're LET GO. It's nothing personal. It's restructuring.
I'm selling you INTEREST. Patience is free, and I don't stock free things.
And if they run? COLLECTIONS. One little tug and they're back in your life, where they belong.
Unnecessary — I'm three days from escaping via a spoon-based device. But fine. Expedite me.
Three hits. THREE. That lock was rated for forty. I'm docking OmniScrap's supplier review to one star.
It fires a sphere of litigation that forks smaller lawsuits at bystanders, then detonates. Four hundred terawatts of don't-touch-it. You may touch it.
Before you ask: yes, that's a forge. No, you can't afford it. Yes, you'll pay anyway.
When OmniScrap arrested me, they seized the prototype schematics. Every page. Even the doodles. ESPECIALLY the doodles.
I re-built this one from memory, which is better than the original, which was also perfect.
Bring me a weapon at V5 with every mod installed, plus two thousand bolts. I'll teach it things its manufacturer never did. The manufacturer was me. I was holding back.
It EVOLVES. Gold Omega, new name, new tricks, a very small amount of screaming. From the weapon. Mostly.
And the patent is PENDING. B-L-Z, four-oh-four-one-seven. If you ever see this design anywhere else in the universe, call me. Then call a lawyer. Then call me back so I can gloat.
Nowhere! The schematics are in an OmniScrap vault, and OmniScrap is about to stop existing. What's the worst that can happen to confiscated paperwork in a fire sale?
That weapon is a CHILD. Use it until it's seen things. Then bring it back.
It has no signature. Every masterpiece needs a signature. Mine is on the invoice.
OVERTIME. It works late, it never asks for a raise, and it sets things on fire. Ideal employee.
HEADLINER! Bigger floor, bigger drop, and the crowd pays double. That's showbiz.
INJUNCTION. Now they can't even fight back while they read it. Legally that's called 'winning'.
ORTHODONTIST. Five gardens, faster chewing, and the bill arrives in installments.
Which makes it better than the original. Which was ALSO perfect. Bring me a gun that's maxed out and bored, and I'll give it a personality.
A filing cabinet, probably! Corporations don't steal ideas to USE them, kid. They steal them to own the drawer.
Because one day somebody's going to try to sell it back to you, and I want you to SEE it.
It's a gun with a FUTURE.
Sold! No refunds — refunds imply error, and I don't manufacture those.
Excellent choice. Statistically, MY statistics. It won't explode in the holster. Probably.
No bolts, no boom-boom. Genius runs on revenue, friend.
Come back when your wallet respects my engineering.
I priced this in 'fair' and you brought 'hopeful'. Adorable.
My rescuer! Everything's 0% off, but I'll THINK about you fondly at full price.
You busted me out with percussive force. As an engineer? Respect.
That cell's welds were AMATEUR work. I was nearly free via spoon anyway. Still. Thanks.
The bag is mysterious to YOU. To me it's inventory.
Percussive engineering. The OLDEST engineering.
Tiny robots. I taught them everything. They resent it.
I voided a warranty I WROTE for this. Poetry.
Upgrading MY work? ...Acceptable. Barely necessary. Do it.
Assembled it blindfolded. On a DARE. Still perfect.
If it explodes, it's a feature. I DESIGNED the feature.
Four hundred terawatts of don't-touch-it, and I let YOU hold it. You're welcome.
Recall? A recall is just a feature rollout in reverse. I don't do reverse.
I'll explain slower: boom go big. Bigger boom go bigger. This is graduate-level stuff.
Every one of these is hand-calibrated by me, so blame is also hand-calibrated. At you.
Safety margin? I AM the safety margin.
A tip! For me? I mean — obviously. For me.
Another bolt for the genius fund. The fund is a jar. The jar is the fund.
Keep tipping and I'll name a warhead after you.
You know what? You're my favorite customer. Legally non-binding.
That one's MAXED, champ. Even Blartz has limits. Legally imposed limits.
One.
Two. The welds are already crying.
Pleasure doing business. I'll sell it to the next hero at FULL price. That's the model.
Every bullet is a tiny paragraph of tiny text. It finds the weak point, it highlights the weak point, and then everybody else gets to read it too!
Is the neighbour's lemonade stand doing better than yours? Don't compete — ACQUIRE!
The longer you DON'T pull the trigger, the more it hurts when you DO. That's not a weapon. That's a financial instrument!
AWAY. They go away. Buy the Void Ripper!
Introducing the CLEARANCE RACK! Six spinning barrels of price-tag rounds. Every tag marks down your enemy's armour. Ten percent! Twenty! FIFTY PERCENT OFF!
Nobody knows! No customer has ever survived long enough to check out!
Signing a lease at the family reunion? Don't sign ANYTHING until you've read... THE FINE PRINT!
And with READ CAREFULLY, time slows down so you can really take it all in. Nobody has ever done that. Not once. In history.
HOSTILE TAKEOVER! One beam, one signature, and that goon who was trying to kill you is now a valued member of YOUR team!
Book club running LATE? Neighbour still hasn't returned your casserole dish? Introducing the LATE FEE!
Customers! Wonderful! Ignore the cell — I'm reviewing OmniScrap's welding. It's TERRIBLE. I've left notes.
And you'll be PAID — not in gratitude, in HARDWARE. My masterpiece: THE PATENT PENDING. Exposed coils. Taped warnings. A cooling fan I refuse to explain.
You want me to evolve a gun with EMPTY MOD SLOTS? That's like icing a cake you haven't baked. Buy the mods.
Two thousand. Not 'around' two thousand. Not 'emotionally' two thousand. TWO. THOUSAND.
MOOD KILLER. Five bounces, and every blade has a twin. A very angry twin.
EVERYTHING MUST GO. Including their armour. Including their dignity. Final sale!
DOUBLE FAULT. Two darts, two targets, zero sportsmanship.
TERMS APPLY. Nobody reads them. That's what makes them so EFFECTIVE.
DEEP FREEZE. Nine seconds of ice. Put a hat on the statue. Sell it as art.
EVENT HORIZON. Physics filed a complaint. I filed it under 'later'.
GOLDEN PARACHUTE. When the contract ends, they leave rich. In the sense that they explode into money.
COMPOUND INTEREST. The longer you wait, the more it hurts them. Just like a real bank!
MIDDLE MANAGEMENT. Two of them now. They've already scheduled a meeting about each other.
...It's GRANTED. My patent is GRANTED. Somebody get me a frame. And a tissue. A frame first.
SECOND OPINION. Hits once, thinks about it, hits again. Very thorough. Very medical.
FULL CHARGE. Your robot is now legally a power station. Don't tell the utility board.
THE OMEGA FORGE. Back in business! OmniScrap SEIZED the prototype schematics when they arrested me, so I rebuilt this one from memory.
They took the forge schematics FIRST. Before my shoes! A man's shoes are his business, but a man's patent is his SOUL. PAT. PEND. B-L-Z four-oh-four-one-seven. Write it on your hand.
It's a sunny day at the picnic! But what's this? UNLICENSED geese! Introducing the OMNI-BLASTER — infinite ammo, zero remorse!
Is the barbecue not lit? IT IS NOW. The BOOM BOX — lob it, love it, live at a safe distance from it!
Trim the hedges! Trim the MOOD! BUZZKILL saws bounce off walls THREE times. Ricochet responsibly. Or don't. I'm a salesman, not a cop.
Rude relatives at the reunion? Serve them! CEASE AND DESIST fires a legal document that bounces between wrongdoers, stamping each one SERVED. Litigation: now a spectator sport!
Lawn games! Wholesome! The LAWN DART sticks in ANYTHING — the fence, the grill, that guy. Then it goes off. FUN for the whole family unit!
Keep the drinks cold AND the goons colder! FROSTBYTE freezes enemies into darling ice statues — then SHATTER them for a fountain of bolts! Chores have never paid so well!
Tidying up? The GRAV GRENADE vacuums the whole picnic — ants, enemies, potato salad — into one convenient CLUMP. Then slam it! Physics: finally on YOUR payroll!
Too much to DO at the cookout? Delegate! THE MIDDLEMAN deploys a little drone that takes the heat AND the credit for twelve whole seconds. Management made simple!
PATENT PENDING! I can't tell you what it does — that's PENDING — but legally it's AMAZING and you should give me bolts NOW!
Gardening for the WHOLE family! Plant a ROOT CANAL seed and watch a snapping bio-pal sprout to root your enemies in place! Up to three gardens of pain! Water twice weekly!
Ants at the picnic? Not for long! The VOID RIPPER opens a tasteful little hole in reality. The ants go... somewhere. We don't ask.
Grandma's lemonade needs CHILLING and your enemies need CHAINING! The ZAPINATOR arcs between up to six wrongdoers. Refreshing!
KA-CHING! You now own the finest hardware in six systems. Do NOT read the sticker.
SOLD! To the hero with the questionable haircut!
